title: Officials endorse a multi-generational crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: also seen past directors of the CIA, congressmen and women, and whistleblowers across agencies endorsing the existence of a decades-long, multi-generational UFO crash retrieval and reverse engineering program.

plain: Former CIA directors, members of Congress and whistleblowers from several agencies are said to have backed the existence of a secret programme, running for decades, that recovers crashed UFOs and takes them apart to copy how they work, called "reverse engineering." Michels says this himself at the start of an episode, as a summary, without naming any of the officials. If true, it would mean the government has held such craft across generations.
